title: Variational Augmented Invertible Koopman Autoencoder for probabilistic time series forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.37435v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural Koopman autoencoder models have been shown to successfully build a latent embedding with linear dynamics for arbitrary dynamical systems, enabling strong performance in long-term time series forecasting. However, these models usually work in a deterministic setting, which does not allow the quantification of the uncertainty of their predictions. Thus, we propose the new Variational Augmented Invertible Koopman AutoEncoder (VAIKAE), in which the latent embedding follows a Gaussian distribution instead of being deterministic. A key property of the VAIKAE architecture is that it leverages normalizing flow models, enabling the use of likelihood computations in the state space of dynamical systems for training a model. We further propose new strategies for uncertainty-aware latent data assimilation with a trained VAIKAE model. translated_title: 用于概率时间序列预测的变分增强可逆Koopman自编码器
translated_abstract: 神经Koopman自编码器模型已被证明能够成功地为任意动力系统构建具有线性动力学的潜在嵌入，从而在长期时间序列预测中表现出强大的性能。然而，这些模型通常在确定性设置下工作，无法对其预测的不确定性进行量化。因此，我们提出了新的变分增强可逆Koopman自编码器（VAIKAE），其中的潜在嵌入遵循高斯分布而非确定性形式。VAIKAE架构的一个关键特性是它利用了归一化流模型，使得能够在动力系统的状态空间中使用似然计算来训练模型。我们进一步提出了使用训练好的VAIKAE模型进行不确定性感知的潜在数据同化的新策略。我们的方法的有效性在一系列长期时间序列预测实验中得到了验证。
tldr: 提出了变分增强可逆Koopman自编码器（VAIKAE），通过将潜在嵌入建模为高斯分布并利用归一化流模型，实现了概率时间序列预测中的不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Variational Augmented Invertible Koopman AutoEncoder (VAIKAE), which models the latent embedding as a Gaussian distribution and leverages normalizing flow models to enable uncertainty quantification in probabilistic time series forecasting.
